intro_detail: I make games, I’m interested in AI and I like 3D rendering. Here are a few personal projects.
projects_intro: Games and other projects I’ve made in my spare time.
spellwar_summary: A 3D game with a custom engine in C++ and OpenGL.
spellwar_detail: A third-person game set on floating platforms. The engine is written in C++ with OpenGL and handles rendering, animation, controls and the camera.
spellwar_focus: Code the engine and the game, from 3D rendering to controls.
plants_summary: Plants generated from rules using L-systems.
plants_detail: This project uses L-systems to generate plants. The program applies a set of rules to draw branches and leaves.
plants_focus: Grow plants from a few rules.
eyefox_summary: An Android puzzle where you have to make two grids match.
eyefox_detail: The goal is to make two grids match. Changing a tile’s colour also changes its neighbours. The game is written in Java for Android.
eyefox_focus: Build a puzzle around this rule and make it work on a phone.
about_intro: I’m Mathis, an engineering graduate from ENSICAEN.
about_body: I also code in my spare time, mostly for fun. I like making games and I’m particularly interested in AI and 3D rendering.
about_outro: I work in Product & Software Engineering, looking after the product from conversations with the client through to development and deployment.
approach_1_body: The game itself, but also the engine, the controls and everything going on behind the scenes.
approach_2_body: Models, how they work and what you can do with them.
approach_3_body: Game rendering, plants generated with code and images you can make with maths.
